newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Tel estimate up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tadiran Tel estimate up.

text.p: UBS Ltd said it rated Tadiran Telecommunications a buy and raised its estimate for 1996-1998 earnings after the company's reported higher-than-expected third quarter earnings per share (EPS).
UBS said it was increasing its EPS estimates about $0.10 each to $1.74 in 1996, $1.85 in 1997, and $2.05 in 1998.

"At about 13 times 1997 and 11 to 12 times 1998 earnings, Tadiran Telecommunications is still a reasonable to compelling value. Thus, despite a 60 percent price appreciation since the initial public offering earlier this year we continue to rate the stock a buy," UBS director of Israel research Daniel Carasso said in a report.

He said the company still treated Bezeq Israel Telecom as a "number one customer" while diversifying its revenue base overseas and said Bezeq in 1997 would account for one-third of sales with exports likely to pass 50 percent.
In the current quarter exports were about equal to sales to Bezeq with each at just over 40 percent.

"This change of sales mix is important as it reduces the risk associated with the stock and enables relative multiple appreciation over time," he said, adding the company's cash- rich balance sheet would help international distribution.
Israel's Tadiran Telecom is a subsidiary of Tadiran Ltd.
